name: Hoshiiro no Okurimono
source: The story is set in a school that will be torn down in a few months. This is announced to the heroine, a student of the school, some months before her graduation. The heroine and her 3 other school mates (all boys) decide to  start an astronomy club, so they can find the best starry sky and make some memories before their graduation.
translation: 故事發生在一所幾個月後即將拆除的學校。女主角是該校學生，在畢業前幾個月得知了這個消息。她與其他三名男同學決定成立天文社，尋找最美的星空，在畢業前共同留下一些回憶。
